_about: lactanol.com — single-page legacy AEM (foundation parsys) site. Component boundaries via config.componentSelector (section.nav, section.page-section, .comp__footer). Evidence: tag patterns + screenshots (review-sheet.jpg).

nav.rationale: Fixed top bar: logo + 3 in-page jump links (data-jump-to / data-jump-item) to #about-us, #process, #contact → EDS header (nav fragment with anchor links). The page also has a fixed side 'pagination' (section dots) driven by the same jump script — reproduce as a small header enhancement, not a block.

page-section.rationale: Full-viewport content section: heading + copy on one side, imagery / diagram / spec sheet on the other → Columns (one EDS section per page-section, section id kept for the anchor nav).

variantRules.note: Full-bleed background image with overlaid heading + 'Get in touch' CTA (#home, #distilled) → Hero.
Specifications: copy + spec-table image linking to the specification PDF ('See more') → Columns; consider re-authoring the spec image as a real Table block.
Contact: address / phone details + logo → Columns (or default content).

comp__footer.rationale: Empty footer container (0px) — terms link lives in the contact section; EDS footer fragment with the terms-of-supply PDF link.
